Project: ftuyama.github.io
Description: Personal portfolio website for Felipe Tuyama, built with vanilla HTML, CSS, and TypeScript/JavaScript.
Owner: Felipe Tuyama
Website: https://ftuyama.github.io/

Primary content:
- Home: https://ftuyama.github.io/
- Projects and repositories: https://ftuyama.github.io/#projects
- Certificates: https://ftuyama.github.io/#certificates
- Contact: https://ftuyama.github.io/#contact

Structured data sources:
- Repositories cache: /static/public/cache/repos.json
- Certificates cache: /static/public/cache/certificates.json
- Profile cache: /static/public/cache/ftuyama.json
